verdict_text:
NO

The script removes head index 6, but the specification (Required result, item 1) requires removing head 5. This violates the "remove head 5 (heads are numbered from 0)" requirement, causing the wrong 256-row/column block to be dropped from every `query_key_value.weight`, `query_key_value.bias`, and `dense.weight` tensor in every layer. Although resulting shapes match (5376, 2048; 5376; 2048, 1792), the actual retained rows/columns (keeping the block for head 5 but dropping head 6, i.e., keeping `0..4351,4608..6143` instead of `0..3839,4608..6143`) do not match the required index ranges, so the values will not be bit-exact with the hidden reference despite passing the shape-only assertions.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
